flags.message: This docket (No. 25-1252) is a Rule 20 petition for a writ of mandamus (docket text: 'Petition for a writ of mandamus filed'), not a petition for certiorari. It is banded 'baseline' under sal-v4 and will be scored against the cert-petition band base rate (pooled OT2017-2024 bracketed 'reached' rate about 5%). Extraordinary-writ petitions are a different population whose modern grant rate is effectively zero, so the band rate is a poor yardstick here; maintainers may want the scope rules or the salience scorer to tag Rule 20 petitions separately. I anchored on the band as instructed and adjusted sharply downward for the writ form.

No filed-document text was provisioned (no record/documents/ directory). The petition PDF on supremecourt.gov exceeded the web-fetch tool's 10 MB limit, so the petition's own text and questions presented could not be read. The forecast rests on the SCOTUS docket, the district court's remand memorandum and recommendation (S.D. Tex. 3:20-cv-00223, Dkt. 186, read via the CourtListener MCP), and the Court's 2024 DeVillier opinion.
